$comment: Paperclip control-plane adapters (Phase 3). Exclusively network adapters — hermes_local is FORBIDDEN inside the container (spec ADR-01). URLs target host.docker.internal; on Linux docker-compose maps it via extra_hosts. Secret values are injected from .env by docker compose / start.sh — never hardcode secrets here (R8).

adapters.$comment_persistSession: ADR-05 / Paperclip #1160: false until the session-ID regex fix is validated upstream.

adapters.$comment: Auth header validated against installed goose 1.56.0 (Bearer is rejected with 401). Spawn on demand via the Host Launcher (ADR-07): POST http://host.docker.internal:9000/launch?profile=dev&engine=goose

launcher.$comment: ADR-07 — daemon lifecycle management. The launcher binds 127.0.0.1 by default; if container-originated triggers are needed, start it with LAUNCHER_HOST=0.0.0.0 (secret then mandatory).
